#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define pii pair<int,int>
#define mp make_pair
#define inf 100000000
#define nn 6000

namespace mcmf {
    struct Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, cost;
    };
    vector<Edge> g[nn];
    void add_edge(int x, int y, int c, int w) {
        g[x].push_back({y, (int)g[y].size(), c, w});
        g[y].push_back({x, (int)g[x].size()-1, 0, -w});
    }

    int dist[nn], vis[nn], prex[nn], prei[nn];
    void spfa(int s) {
        memset(dist, 0x3f, sizeof dist);
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
        prex[s] = -1;
        deque<int> q;
        q.push_back(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        vis[s] = 1;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.front(); q.pop_front();
            vis[x] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[x].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = g[x][i];
                if (e.cap && dist[e.to] > dist[x] + e.cost) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[x] + e.cost;
                    prex[e.to] = x;
                    prei[e.to] = i;
                    if (!vis[e.to]) {
                        vis[e.to] = 1;
                        if (!q.empty() && dist[e.to] < dist[q.front()])
                            q.push_front(e.to);
                        else
                            q.push_back(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int tot = 0;
    int dfs(int x, int flow) {
        if (prex[x] == -1) return flow;
        int y = x;
        x = prex[y];
        int i = prei[y];
        Edge &e = g[x][i];
        int f = dfs(x, min(flow, e.cap));
        e.cap -= f;
        g[y][e.rev].cap += f;
        return f;
    }

    pii solve(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0;
        tot = 0;
        while (1) {
            spfa(s);
            if (dist[t] > 1e9) break;
            int f = dfs(t, inf);
            tot += f * dist[t];
            ans += f;
        }
        return mp(ans, tot);
    }
};

int n, m, s = nn-1, t = nn-2;
int k, c, d;
int get(int x, int tim) {
    return tim * 52 - 52 + x;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    int kk = k;
    while (k--) {
        int x; scanf("%d", &x);
        mcmf::add_edge(s, get(x,1), 1, 0);
    }
    k = kk;
    while (m--) {
        int x, y; scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j)
                mcmf::add_edge(get(x,i), get(y,i+1), 1, d*(j+j-1));
        swap(x, y);
        for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j)
                mcmf::add_edge(get(x,i), get(y,i+1), 1, d*(j+j-1));
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
            mcmf::add_edge(get(j,i), get(j,i+1), inf, 0);
        mcmf::add_edge(get(1,i), t, inf, c*(i-1));
    }
    printf("%d", mcmf::solve(s,t).second);
    return 0;
}
